theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ac_pp_unit_rectifiable_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable η (μHE[m].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[m].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M y Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η y) Q) → ∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, IsIntegerMultiplicity D ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Integrable (fun y => η y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y)) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ D ω = ∫ y in M, η y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), D.massOn W' ≤ μHE[m] (M ∩ W')
